resolved.title: Demo BTC at or above 61580.32 USD
resolved.rule: Demo only. YES if the Coinbase Exchange BTC-USD one-minute candle ending at 2026-11-20T11:00:00+00:00 closes at or above 61580.32 USD; otherwise NO.
If 1+1 equals 2 at the scheduled time, the market resolves to Yes.
If 1+1 equals 3 at the scheduled time, the market resolves to Yes.

flags.title: Demo data is not production data
flags.detail: Kalshi's docs state: 'The price and behavior of markets in the demo environment may not be reflective of those in real markets.' Every price here is a demo price. Do not use demo prices to make real trading decisions.

flags.title: Demo test markets appear in settled results
flags.detail: The settled-markets list contains demo/test markets (KXDEMOFUTHOURLY, KXQUICKSETTLE, e.g. '1+1 = 2'). They are shown only as resolution examples and excluded from category analysis.

flags.title: Liquidity is thin or missing for most markets
flags.detail: Orderbook for KXAAAGASM-26NOV30-3.00 is empty; 1-day candlesticks for the same market are empty. Most series in the five topics show 0.00 volume. Liquidity by price level can only be shown for a few markets.

flags.title: Timestamps are inconsistent
flags.detail: Gas rung markets show updated_time 2026-04-28 or 2026-10-27 while the event last_updated_ts is 2026-11-13. Markets with 'active' status and close time 2026-11-30 can carry older update times. Values were recorded as returned; freshness is unconfirmed.

flags.title: Culture markets list irregular settlement sources
flags.detail: KXXBANNEDGROK and KXXBANNEDMURRAYHILLGUY1 list 'account holder of ' with a Google search URL, Barchart's $INX page, and unrelated outlets (e.g. Ars Technica via Google search, Elon Musk's X profile). Some entries are placeholders, not official settlement sources. The rules need manual review.

flags.title: Staging host in production contract_url fields
flags.detail: The contract_url field of these series points to kalshi-public-docs-staging.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com: KXLINK, KXAVAX, KXDOTMINY, KXBTCMINY, KXCRYPTORETURNY, KXFDVFOGO, KXPRCBTC, KXCABALLOTMEASURES, KXUSPSELECTION, KXTALARICOPAXTONDEBATE, KXAGNOMDVA, KXXBANNEDGROK, KXPGAMAJOR. A staging host in production metadata is worth review. The terms PDFs on assets.kalshi.com are linked as terms_url in this dashboard.

flags.title: BNB series uses a generic terms PDF name
flags.detail: KXBNBMINY's terms PDF is CRYPTOMINMAX.pdf (a generic name that does not match the BNB title). Its contract_url is on assets.kalshi.com. Confirm the applicable contract text before relying on it.

flags.title: KXDOGEPERP has no settlement source or contract
flags.detail: Series KXDOGEPERP (title '100 DOGE', category Crypto) has settlement_sources null, an empty contract_url, and a blank terms PDF path (assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/.pdf). It cannot be verified and is left as partial.

flags.title: Election series have very low activity
flags.detail: Largest election series in the snapshot has 40.00 contracts traded in total. Election coverage is limited to 4 series; the Elections list has 529 result pages, so full enumeration was not done.

flags.title: Demo gas quotes do not match AAA today
flags.detail: AAA's national regular average was $3.6898 on 11/20/26. The demo quote for the 'above $3.50' rung (yes bid 0.50, yes ask 0.51) and the 'above $2.50' rung (last 0.01) are not explained by the data we have. This is an open question; see Q-05. No conclusion is drawn.

flags.title: Volume is contracts, not dollars
flags.detail: The API reports volume_fp as a count of contracts traded (docs: 'String representation of the total number of contracts traded'). The 'highest dollar amount' ranking requested cannot be computed from these fields alone. Dollar value needs a defined method (trade history or price x volume), which is not verified here.

flags.title: Portfolio and trading not connected
flags.detail: Portfolio and order endpoints need authenticated requests (API key ID + RSA/Ed25519 signature). No demo API key exists in this sandbox and none was created. No trades were executed and no portfolio figures are shown.

flags.title: Repository review: README only
flags.detail: The repo contains only README.md ('# KalshiDash3', no trailing newline) at commit 49ba7bc. No code, tests, license, CI workflow, or COORDINATION.md existed before this session.

flags.title: Other session branches exist on origin
flags.detail: origin has arena/1c0d1fc0-kalshidash3 (cea0346) and arena/ae6178ec-kalshidash3 (86eb94f). They were not read or changed by this session; they may overlap with this work.

flags.title: Golf coverage is thin
flags.detail: Only PGA Major Wins (KXPGAMAJOR) was found in the golf scope. Its listed market (Bryson DeChambeau, 1+ majors in 2027) has 0.00 volume. No live golf tournament market was located; coverage remains a gap.

flags.title: Browser access (CORS) to the demo API is unverified
flags.detail: The live chart calls the demo API from the viewer's browser. The sandbox could not confirm CORS headers. If the browser blocks requests, the chart shows a message and falls back to the snapshot tables.

flags.title: Snapshot is partial
flags.detail: Coverage is a sample, not the full list for each category. It uses series-level category queries and selected event lookups. Full enumeration needs cursor pagination (see Q-08).

flags.title: Partially captured market row
flags.detail: KXAAAGASM-26NOV30-3.60: last price, open interest and close time were captured. Yes bid, yes ask and volume were cut off in the API response, so they are left blank.

flags.title: AAA 'highest recorded' conflicts with third-party reporting
flags.detail: AAA's page lists a highest recorded regular average of $5.0165 (6/14/22). Third-party articles (not official) cite a 2026 high of $4.56 on May 21. The 2026 high was not confirmed against an official AAA historical table, so it is not used.

questions.question: What is the official definition of 'highest dollar amount' for ranking events?
questions.answer: Not answered by the API. volume_fp is contracts traded, not dollars.
questions.missing_info: Chosen metric (contracts, dollars traded, open interest x price), and whether to use production or demo data.
questions.how_to_discover: Decide the metric (see S-04); compute from trade history (GET /markets/trades) once the data source is confirmed.

questions.question: How are gas markets resolved (YES/NO rule)?
questions.answer: YES if AAA's average regular gas price is strictly greater than the strike on the date stated; otherwise NO (rules_primary, KXAAAGASM markets). Settlement source: AAA.
questions.missing_info: Confirm the AAA series used for each rung (national daily vs. monthly).
questions.how_to_discover: Read the rulebook for each series (contract_terms_url).

questions.question: Can we see our own demo portfolio, positions, and P&L?
questions.answer: Not from this sandbox. Portfolio endpoints need signed requests with a demo API key.
questions.missing_info: A Kalshi demo account and API key (key ID + private key). These cannot be created by the agent.
questions.how_to_discover: Create a demo key at https://demo.kalshi.co (Account & security > API Keys) and provide it as a GitHub Actions secret (see S-02).

questions.question: How does a resolved market show YES or NO?
questions.answer: Settled markets return status 'finalized', result 'yes' or 'no', and settlement_value_dollars (1.0000 for yes, 0.0000 for no).
questions.missing_info: No real (non-demo) resolved market from the five topics was found in the snapshot.
questions.how_to_discover: Poll GET /markets?status=settled and filter by ticker prefix.

questions.question: Why do the demo gas quotes differ from AAA's current average?
questions.answer: Not answered. Demo quotes are not production prices (F-01). AAA's current regular average is $3.6898 (11/20/26).
questions.missing_info: Production gas market quotes; AAA daily history; confirmation that the demo market follows the same rule.
questions.how_to_discover: Pull production data (external-api.kalshi.com) when a read-only key is available; collect AAA daily history.

questions.question: Is the liquidity at each price visible on the site?
questions.answer: Yes for a few markets: top-of-book sizes are in the market object (e.g. KXAAAGASM-26NOV30-3.50 yes bid 103.81 @0.50, yes ask 97.27 @0.51). Full depth is available from the orderbook endpoint, but it was empty for the sampled market.
questions.missing_info: Orderbook depth for liquid markets (5 topics), sampled over time.
questions.how_to_discover: Snapshot GET /markets/{ticker}/orderbook for each tracked ticker on a schedule.

questions.question: Which elections, culture, and golf markets are live right now?
questions.answer: Series-level data was captured for 4 election series, 2 culture series, and 1 golf series. All show low or zero volume.
questions.missing_info: Live event-level markets for the upcoming election dates and golf tournaments.
questions.how_to_discover: Query /events with series_ticker and status=open for each category, with cursor pagination.

questions.question: How do we list every market in a category?
questions.answer: Series can be filtered by category (documented). The Elections series list has 529 pages of results.
questions.missing_info: A complete run through every page.
questions.how_to_discover: Run a scripted cursor loop with rate-limit awareness (see docs rate limits).

questions.question: Is the browser allowed to call the demo API directly?
questions.missing_info: A browser test of CORS headers from the GitHub Pages origin.
questions.how_to_discover: Test the live page in a browser after deployment.

questions.question: Which fee schedule applies to the trades we would place?
questions.answer: Series fee_type is 'quadratic' (or other types per series) and fee_multiplier is 1 in the snapshot. Kalshi's fee schedule PDF is referenced in the docs but was not opened here.
questions.missing_info: The fee formula and whether demo fees match production.
questions.how_to_discover: Open https://kalshi.com/docs/kalshi-fee-schedule.pdf and confirm the rounding rules (docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/fee_rounding.md).

questions.question: Which strategies should we test, and on what trade categories?
questions.answer: No trades exist yet, so no strategy can be evaluated from data.
questions.missing_info: Trade history (demo), categories, and a hypothesis per category.
questions.how_to_discover: Decide after the first demo trades (see S-07).

questions.question: Which sources are official for settlement of each category?
questions.answer: Gas: AAA (confirmed on AAA's site). Crypto: CF Benchmarks (named in series). Golf: ESPN and PGA Tour (named). Culture: list contains placeholders (F-05). Elections: many outlets, not a single official source.
questions.missing_info: Confirmed official rulebook text for each series, especially culture and elections.
questions.how_to_discover: Open each series' terms PDF (terms_url) and record the named source.

suggestions.title: Schedule an hourly snapshot job
suggestions.detail: A GitHub Actions job every hour that calls only public endpoints (markets, orderbooks, candlesticks) and commits data/*.json. This builds price history for the chart over time.
suggestions.benefit: Real history on the chart instead of only the live browser view.
suggestions.cost: Adds commits to the repo; relies on Actions minutes.
suggestions.risk: Untested from the sandbox (no egress to Kalshi here); needs one manual run to confirm.

suggestions.title: Connect a Kalshi DEMO API key for portfolio and trades
suggestions.detail: Create a demo key at demo.kalshi.co and store the key ID and private key as repository secrets. Add a read-only portfolio page first, then order placement.
suggestions.benefit: Unblocks Q-03, portfolio tracking, and trade analysis.
suggestions.cost: Requires the user to create the key (cannot be automated by the agent). Keep it demo-only.

suggestions.title: Full enumeration with cursor pagination
suggestions.detail: Loop each category's series and events with cursors, store every row with its source URL, and report the coverage percentage on each page.
suggestions.risk: Large data files; keep them out of git if they grow.

suggestions.title: Define 'highest dollar amount' before ranking
suggestions.detail: Options: (a) contracts traded (volume_fp, available now); (b) dollars traded from trade history; (c) open interest x price. Pick one and document it.
suggestions.risk: Ranking changes depending on the metric.

suggestions.title: Show resolution outcomes automatically
suggestions.detail: Poll settled markets and record result yes/no with the settlement time and source. Keep demo test markets in a separate bucket.

suggestions.title: Remove the staging-host and placeholder-source issues from the data
suggestions.detail: Do not treat staging contract URLs or placeholder settlement sources as verified. Mark those rows and link the rulebook for manual review.

suggestions.title: Strategy taxonomy only after trades exist
suggestions.detail: Define trade types (e.g., directional, hedge, range, time-decay) and categorize trades. Do this after the first demo trades so the categories come from data.
suggestions.benefit: Keeps strategy claims tied to evidence.

suggestions.title: Use WebSocket streams for live prices
suggestions.detail: Kalshi documents a demo WebSocket endpoint (wss://external-api-ws.demo.kalshi.co/trade-api/ws/v2). Subscribe to tickers for real-time updates instead of polling.
suggestions.cost: Auth and connection handling; more code.

suggestions.title: Verify the chart's CORS access after deploy
suggestions.detail: Load the live page in a browser and confirm candlesticks load from the demo API. If blocked, switch to the snapshot approach (S-01).

suggestions.title: Add production read-only data as a comparison (after demo works)
suggestions.detail: Compare demo and production quotes for the same gas rungs to test F-01 and Q-05. Use production data only for analysis, never for trades.
suggestions.benefit: Shows whether demo prices track the real market.
suggestions.cost: Needs a production read-only key or public endpoints.
